## What this letter says
Your scan on 18 September 2026 shows that the cancer has spread to your liver.
Dr Chen would like to meet you. You will talk about your treatment options.

## What you need to do
1. Go to your appointment with Dr Chen. It is on Thursday 5 November 2026 at 11:00.
2. You are welcome to bring a family member or friend. This is optional.
3. If you want to talk to someone before then, you can call the cancer nurse specialist team on 01632 960 471. This is optional.

## Dates and medicines
- 18 September 2026: the scan that showed the cancer has spread to your liver.
- Thursday 5 November 2026 at 11:00: appointment with Dr Chen to talk about treatment options.
- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What are my treatment options?
- What will happen at the appointment?
- Who can I call if I have questions before then?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
